title: A public window on the world
changes: Public atlas preview checkpoint: civilization inspection, full update history, dismissal, browser Back and refresh have been checked on the published site.
Responsive preview layouts retain civilization inspection without horizontal overflow at narrow and phone-width CSS viewports.
Compatible viewer preferences include Borders and Routes visibility, camera position, zoom, decorative motion and the civilization in focus.
Browsers without WebGL 2 retain a useful text and inspection view. The growing world roadmap continues toward connected civilizations and Mars; this release does not add live gameplay.

title: The first atlas
changes: Original Three.js atlas preview with five illustrative civilizations, procedural terrain, capital cities and trade routes.
Spectator-only camera, touch navigation and civilization inspection. This preview does not run live agents or gameplay.
Accessible update history, deployment version checks and compatible viewer preference restoration.
The world roadmap connects early history to Mars, with five AI civilizations and a sixth AI World Director.
